note: One Devotion: one player's reading of one Cognition, held in a Deeper Burn. Paragon Abilities are written for each character with their DM, so they can't be generated from a Cognition's own JSON — they live here. The shape deliberately mirrors a Cognition file: name / icon / description / savingThrow / damageType / engine are the same meta fields, `abilities` is grouped the way `verumEffects` is, and every ability carries a four-entry `tiers` ladder for Ranks I-IV. A tier is a string, or {text, card, mech} — the same tolerance a Cognition tier has. Formula shorthands: {VM} {PB} {DC} {ATK} as everywhere else, plus {{ ... }} for arithmetic over VM, PB, DC, ATK, LVL and RANK. The file name is the id: <owner>_<cognition>_devotion.json, with the owner's username, or `example` for the rules' own worked sets.
name: The Stained Crescent
description: The shell is a promise. While Protection burns, a pale silver crescent hangs at Zeke's back, and the air around him goes still and heavy.

passive.name: Crescent Ward
passive.description: Stand close enough and the stillness covers you too.
passive.text: Allies within 10 feet of you gain +1 AC.

offensive.name: Answering Blow
offensive.description: Everything done to them is owed back.
offensive.text: You make a melee weapon attack. On a hit, the target takes your weapon's damage plus extra force damage. The extra damage also adds your Verum Modifier for each ally within 30 feet who has taken damage since the end of your last turn.

tiers.text: An extra 2d10 force damage, counting up to 3 hurt allies.
tiers.card: +2d10 force, +{VM} per hurt ally within 30 ft (up to 3)

tiers.text: An extra 4d10, counting up to 5 hurt allies. Until the end of its next turn the target has disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you.
tiers.card: +4d10, up to 5 hurt allies · the target can only swing at you without disadvantage

tiers.text: An extra 6d10, and twice your Verum Modifier per hurt ally. It ignores resistances and immunities if the target caused any of that damage.
tiers.card: +6d10, +{{2*VM}} per hurt ally · ignores resistance and immunity if it did the hurting

tiers.text: An extra 8d10. For 1 minute, when an ally within 30 feet is hit, you can use your reaction to deal half this damage to the attacker.
tiers.card: +8d10 · for 1 min, a reaction answers any hit on an ally within 30 ft for half this damage
